parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue by ensuring dimensions are correctly identified for functions, but it may introduce unintended behavior.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new behavior where dimensions are set to Dimension(1) if they are dimensionless, which might not be the intended behavior for all functions and could lead to unexpected results in other parts of the code.
